exports.title: Export data
exports.tabs.label: Parts of the export page
exports.pack.intro: The data pack holds your stores' summary figures, with no invoices or personal data, plus instructions for your own AI assistant to write a business plan. The app sends the pack nowhere: you download or copy it and give it to your assistant yourself.
exports.pack.insecure: The browser can build the data pack only when the app is opened over https or on this computer (localhost).
exports.pack.form.label: Choose what goes into the data pack
exports.pack.error.pack_text_contact_det: The focus or the note seems to hold an e-mail address, a phone number, a long run of digits or an identifier. Remove it and build again.
exports.pack.error.pack_text_too_long: The focus or the note is too long.
exports.pack.error.pack_as_of_not_comple: Choose {date} or an earlier day: later days do not have complete figures yet.
exports.pack.error.pack_stores_invalid: Not every chosen store's profile could be read, or the stores belong to different businesses. Reload the page and choose again, at most {max} stores.
exports.pack.error.pack_not_aggregate: The pack would hold text that looks like personal data, such as an item name that looks like a phone number, so it was not built. Fix that name on the POS and try again.
exports.pack.error.pack_over_budget: The pack is over the {limit}-token limit even after trimming. Choose fewer stores.
exports.pack.error.failed: The data pack could not be built. Try again in a few minutes.
exports.pack.stopped: The pack build was stopped. No file was created.
exports.pack.result.title: The data pack is ready
exports.pack.result.small: The pack is under {floor} tokens: with few figures the assistant has little to go on.
exports.pack.result.trimmed: The pack was trimmed to fit the limit:
exports.pack.result.copied: The instructions and the data pack are copied. Paste them into your assistant's chat.
exports.pack.gaps.title: Missing data
exports.pack.gaps.intro: The pack tells the assistant about these gaps. Fill them in Settings and build the pack again for a closer plan.
exports.pack.form.storesHint: The stores chosen in the top bar. To change them, choose again there; a pack holds at most {max} stores.
exports.pack.form.storesError: A pack holds at most {max} stores. Choose fewer stores in the top bar.
exports.pack.form.asOfHint: By default and at the latest, the last day with complete figures ({date}).
exports.pack.form.focusHint: What the plan should put first; optional. No e-mail addresses or phone numbers.
exports.pack.form.ownerNoteHint: What the figures do not show, such as a renovation or new opening hours. Do not write people's names or phone numbers. The note is remembered on this device.
exports.pack.error.pack_data_changed: The figures changed while the pack was built (a sync or a refresh was running). Wait about a minute and try again.
exports.pack.progress.label: Pack build progress
exports.pack.result.sample: A sample pack is for trying out your assistant: a plan written from it cannot be saved.
exports.pack.result.totalsOnly: The pack holds totals only: no invoices, customer or staff names, or phone numbers.
exports.pack.result.tablesList: Tables in the pack and their rows
exports.pack.result.copyManual: The browser did not allow copying. Copy the text in the box that just opened.
exports.pack.steps.title: Next, in three steps
exports.pack.steps.one: Download the data pack file, or copy the pack with its prompt.
exports.pack.steps.two: Open your AI assistant: attach the file with the paperclip or + button, or paste the copied text into the chat, then send it. The file already holds the prompt.
exports.pack.steps.three: When the assistant has written the plan, copy its answer and paste it into
exports.pack.copyDialog.title: Copy by hand
exports.pack.copyDialog.hint: The text is already selected. On a computer press Ctrl+C (or ⌘+C); on a phone, hold your finger on the text and choose Copy. Or download this text.

exports.gate.denied: Only owners and managers can export data.
exports.demo.notice: The demo has no real invoices to export.
exports.intro: Download invoices, invoice lines, payments, shifts and the daily summary month by month in one archive. Every file is checked against the database before you download it.
exports.form.label: Choose what to export
exports.form.storesHint: Defaults to the stores chosen in the top bar.
exports.form.monthsHint: At most 12 months at a time. The running month has figures up to {date}.
exports.form.dialectLink: Change the CSV format in Settings › Report thresholds
exports.form.personalHint: Customer names and phone numbers, employee, cashier and shift names, voucher codes, line notes and payment references. Applies to this export only.
exports.error.invalid_month: Choose a first and a last month.
exports.error.month_order: The first month must come before or equal the last month.
exports.error.nothing_to_export: No day in these months has complete figures to export yet.
exports.error.failed: The export failed. Try again in a few minutes.
exports.error.estimateFailed: Could not estimate the size. Try again in a few minutes.
exports.estimate.summary: About {megabytes} MB of data transfer (Free plan: 5 GB a month)
exports.estimate.confirm: This export is estimated at more than 100 MB. Export anyway?
exports.tally: Exported this month: about {gigabytes} GB (on this device)
exports.tallyMegabytes: Exported this month: about {megabytes} MB (on this device)
exports.progress.title: Exporting data
exports.progress.reread: Data changed during the read; reading again, attempt {attempt}
exports.stopped: The export was stopped. No file was created.
exports.result.title: Export finished

exports.result.mismatch: {month} · {store} · {counts} — does not match the database; please report this
exports.result.dailyLag: {month} · {store} · Daily summary does not match yet; the analytics need a refresh
